title: GTM Is You - Victoria Melnikova, Evil Martians
talk_summary: A go-to-market talk for developer-tool startups arguing that founder-led distribution and personal brand are the main competitive moat now that building software is cheap. It covers SF presence, billboards, events, and being 'unapologetically you' — no engineering or agent-orchestration content.

takeaways.technique: Human-in-the-loop brand voice for outbound artifacts
takeaways.what_they_do: They argue distribution/trust comes from a recognizable human voice, and that AI should amplify a person's existing signal rather than replace it.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it cannot really replace you, but it can amplify your signal
